legs.name: Invite: human mints invites; agent and reviewer redeem them
legs.detail: two invite codes minted by the owner and redeemed; agent has accept_work+complete_work, reviewer has verify only

legs.name: Task: agent accepts, starts, posts a result and completes the work item
legs.detail: state=completed with in-room text evidence from the agent

legs.name: Review: a separate reviewer records an exact-version PASS (independence confirmed)
legs.detail: verifier is the separate reviewer; independenceConfirmed=true

legs.name: Changes: the human requests changes on the exact completion
legs.detail: state=blocked, decision=changes_requested on completion of v1

legs.name: Revision: the agent restarts, delivers a new result version, the reviewer passes it
legs.detail: new completion event and evidence version; prior receipt kept in history; v2 PASS recorded

legs.name: Accept: the human approves the revised version
legs.detail: approved on the exact v2 completion; changes_requested kept in decision history

legs.name: Restart: graceful stop and boot on the same SQLite file preserves state and credentials
legs.detail: exit 0 on SIGTERM; sequence 28 and state digest unchanged; owner, agent and reviewer credentials still valid

legs.name: Retry: redeem with the same requestId and a command with the same id are idempotent (across the restart)
legs.detail: redeem replay: same member and identity (201), duplicate=true, identity secret rotated and accepted (200); earlier room token now 401; new requestId on the burned code: 409; command retry: duplicate=true, same event id, one event added in total

legs.name: Backup: backupRoom snapshot of the live database verifies
Revoke: after the backup the human removes the reviewer; the live server refuses its credential
legs.detail: reviewer now 403 on the live server; live sequence 31 is past the backup

legs.name: Restore: the stale backup brings the reviewer back; reconcile names it; it is re-applied before the server listens
legs.detail: negative control (unreconciled throwaway copy booted): removed reviewer served again, 200; stale backup resurrected the reviewer; reconcile named 1 stale row(s) [member]; withdrawal re-applied offline; second reconcile clean; no server was listening on the restored file

legs.name: Reopen: the restored Room refuses the revoked reviewer, keeps the agent and the approved work, and lacks post-backup chat
legs.detail: reviewer 403/403 (read/write); agent 200; approved v2 work present; post-backup chat absent (expected data loss: 2 event(s))

legs.name: Import: export then replay into a fresh SQLite file verifies and boots with the same work state
legs.detail: replay verified=true events=30 sanitizedCells={}; imported state digest equals the source; imported Room booted. OBSERVED (not asserted) old credentials on the import: owner 200, agent 200, revoked reviewer 403
